author: NITAUganda1
text: Binance has confirmed a security incident affecting about $6.3 billion in assets, the largest crypto heist on record, overtaking the $1.5 billion Bybit theft. Nearly $3 billion has been frozen.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Critical RCE in FreeSWITCH (CVE-2026-116779) actively exploited, jeopardizing real-time comms data. Patch urgently!

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Patch the Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerability now. This Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain with CVE-2026-104935 is actively exploited in the wild.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Cisco says CVE-2026-76418 is actively exploited. A crafted unauthenticated request can reload affected ASA or FTD firewalls when SSL remote access and secondary authentication are configured. Cisco released fixes; no RCE or data theft is confirmed.

author: cordobahq
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2): unauthenticated RCE in PHP, actively exploited against internet-exposed Palo Alto Networks management interfaces. Fixed in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

author: BytesNora
text: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' Network (CVE-2026-20127, actively exploited)

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-97229 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV, GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition. CVSS 10.0

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Drupal Commerce Core access bypass actively exploited (CVE-2026-118539, SA-CONTRIB-2026-254). Exploited in the wild.

author: DEVOTOMSOLUTION
text: China-linked Warp Panda used VMware ESX flaw CVE-2026-41709 as a zero-day to erase audit logs in US law-firm intrusions. Now on CISA KEV.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: AI-discovered vulnerability CVE-2026-111497 affects the Google-developed Brotli decompression library bundled into many products.

author: cyrus77x
text: Microsoft says China-state aligned Storm-0940 used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply-chain attack. It tried to sign in to 2,250+ tenants.

author: Huntio
text: Inside an AI-Assisted PaperCut Attack Campaign: exposed directories containing AI-agent instructions, exploit code, operational logs, and victim data.

author: WeizmanGal
text: Security flaws in the browsers embedded into Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop, GitHub Copilot, and VSCode: address bar spoofing, prompt injection to RCE, arbitrary local file read.

author: Basant_Pandey
text: agno PandasTools (through 3.1.11) passes a model-chosen function name to getattr(). Prompt injection can make it call read_pickle on an attacker path, code execution. CVE-2026-119050, 9.2.

author: Ranjan22555
text: Strands Agents Tools let an LLM disable secret masking via a tool parameter (CVE-2026-115415). Prompt injection could expose host credentials. Upgrade to 0.8.6+ and rotate exposed keys.

author: disismohi
text: CVE-2026-117567: OS command injection in esp-mcp. Prompt injection to tool call manipulation to arbitrary commands.

author: Andersonqwzx
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised in a supply chain attack. Malicious PyPI packages and Docker images delivered a credential stealer and backdoor targeting cloud credentials, private keys, and AI tool credentials.

author: Teti_sf
text: Binance and Polymarket: two separate incidents on Oct 29. Binance ~$6.3B, compromised DevOps engineer's laptop gave the attacker access to a service container.

author: Brainrot_Labs
text: Polymarket hack traced to a compromised third-party DebugBear monitoring script; supply chain attack confirmed by GoPlus.

author: DiesanRomero
text: A leak of 41,000+ DHS staff records reportedly came from the Okta directory. Okta says it saw no compromise.

author: hackerfact0ry
text: 26,400 working cloud and AI credentials exposed in 7.25M public Git repos: 9,473 Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pairs, 3,170 DeepSeek keys, 1,348 OpenAI API keys.

author: ita_ipo
text: CISA KEV: PHP2Shell RCE chain CVE-2026-109618/109619 actively exploited, used to root servers worldwide. Also in-the-wild: Cisco SD-WAN auth bypass CVE-2026-20127, CVSS 10.0 deploying KeyDrift malware tied to Volt Typhoon.

author: PenTestBids
text: CVE-2026-20127: Critical Cisco SD-WAN authentication bypass actively exploited, CVSS 10.0.

author: TonyBeeTweets
text: CISA flags two actively exploited critical flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud.

author: Wahndo_
text: Major hacks Oct 29: Binance ~$5.8-6.3B drained from hot wallets across multiple chains via compromised engineer laptop + EIP-7702; ~$3B frozen. Florida DOE student financial aid site breach may have exposed SSNs.

author: cvedotnow
text: agno-agi agno: code execution via unsafe reflection in PandasTools (CVE-2026-119050). Attackers can use prompt injection to make the agent run code on the host or read local files. No patch yet.

author: cyb3rops
text: An 11-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability got attention, but the CAIRN/ARTEX agentic AI offensive tooling topic is far more important.

author: 0x0SojalSec
text: Black October: Pentagon personnel data breach (3M people), Denmark population register breach (8.8M), French supermarket freezers remotely disabled, Ahold Delhaize grocery systems knocked offline, largest crypto heist in history.

author: deezen0tes
text: Polymarket international platform suffered a supply-chain attack: compromised DebugBear performance monitoring script injected malicious code into the frontend, draining user funds.

author: Dovydas44444
text: Polymarket security breach compromised its international platform, leading to theft of millions from user accounts; trading temporarily halted.

author: Magnexis
text: Campaign compromised 42 GitHub repositories using malicious payloads designed to evade code search and target AI coding agents, some hidden in files as large as 13.7 MB.

author: penthera_org
text: An MCP server on npm shipped malware: atlisp/mcp 1.12.14 (GHSA-65cr-mcfq-59hh). If your agent started it, treat that machine as compromised and rotate keys.

author: Teknalyze_
text: Attackers exploited GitHub issues to target 61 public repositories, including major open-source projects, in a rapid supply chain attack on automated build pipelines.

author: Iam_Shivanshu
text: AWS bulletin 2026-097-AWS / CVE-2026-85654 / GHSA-35jj-hwvm-792x: code injection in the CDK generator inside awslabs.dynamodb-mcp-server; MCP schema names became template code.

author: nurhayatdev
text: CVE-2026-115413 affects AWS API MCP Server 1.3.0 to <1.6.0: OAuth check validated signature, issuer and expiry but not the aud claim, so a token issued to another app in the same tenant could be accepted.

author: disismohi
text: Kali-GPT (commit a608c74) has a command injection in its MCP server, CVE-2026-117569. Prompt-injected agents can run arbitrary commands via unsanitized scanner parameters.

author: dangsoun
text: Bitcoin Core disclosed three security vulnerabilities discovered through AI scanning, including two that could allow malicious peers to exhaust node memory and crash systems (disclosed Oct 28).

author: molari999
text: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV

author: thecybersecguru
text: Cisco firewall zero-day actively exploited: CVE-2026-76418 (CVSS 8.6) lets unauthenticated attackers remotely crash vulnerable Cisco ASA and FTD firewalls. Patch now.
